collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult who is working)

collection.description: A villager praised as the best at their work secretly feels like a fraud: tell a friend, or keep smiling.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the fire tonight, someone raises a cup to (subject): "The best in the village at what (subject.he/she) does!" Everyone cheers. (subject) smiles and wants to disappear. (subject.He/she) knows about every mistake, every lucky guess, every time (subject.he/she) didn't know and pretended. Surely one day everyone will find out (subject.he/she) is just making it up as (subject.he/she) goes along.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing, a sound or a person out of sight for a moment); nobody leaves the village -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Later, (subject) admits it to (friend). (friend) laughs, not unkindly. "You think anyone knows what they're doing? I've been guessing for years." (subject) isn't sure (subject.he/she) believes (friend.him/her). But it helps to hear it. A little. (subject.He/she) still feels like a fraud. (subject.He/she) feels like a fraud with company.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) smiles and thanks everyone and says nothing. That night (subject.he/she) lies awake going over every mistake. In the morning (subject.he/she) goes to work and does it well, the way (subject.he/she) always does. The feeling doesn't go away. It never has. (subject.He/she) works with it anyway, every day, and nobody can tell.
